usageNotes: Returns the directory index for a specific storage on a remote PVE node — useful for discovering what sub-resources or actions are available under that storage path before drilling into content or status calls. The remote must be reachable from PDM and the node must be online; if either is unavailable the call will fail. The response schema is null in the spec, meaning this is a navigation/index endpoint and not a data-bearing call.

examples.summary: List the index for the 'local-zfs' storage on node 'pve1' of remote 'hetzner-prod'

tips: Use this endpoint to confirm a storage name is valid on a given node before issuing storage-content or status calls.
The 'remote' value must match a remote name registered in PDM, not a hostname or IP.
Because permissions are 'user: all', any authenticated PDM user can call this — no special privilege required.
